data.title: 黑馆晴奈 · 米其林餐厅的优雅品鉴
data.description: 学园都市顶奢法式餐厅的高级靠窗专座，璀璨的水晶吊灯将银质餐具照得流光溢彩。晴奈端坐在天鹅绒高背椅上，白手套轻握精美的银质餐叉。她微微侧过头，猩红眼眸带着真正鉴赏家的审慎与满意，向对座的老师投来赞赏而优雅的迷人注视。
data.action: holding silver fork, sitting poised at dining table, elegant aristocratic smile
data.lighting: brilliant sparkling chandelier radiance and soft table candlelight
data.mood: regal refinement, culinary sophistication, and aristocratic charm
data.promptProse: Seated at an opulent fine dining table beneath crystal chandeliers, Kurodate Haruna holds a silver fork with poised aristocratic elegance, her ruby eyes glowing softly.
data.animaCaption: Haruna holding a silver fork with a poised, aristocratic smile in a luxury restaurant.
